about: Ephesians is Paul's letter about God's love and how to live as God's children.

pages.title: Saved by Grace
pages.scene: A child painting, with God's love all around
pages.text: Paul wrote, "God saved you by His grace, because you trusted Him. It is a gift from God, not something you earned. We are God's work of art, made to do good things."
pages.lesson: You are God's work of art.

pages.title: Put On God's Armor
pages.scene: A child dressed in God's armor
pages.text: Paul said to be strong in the Lord, like a soldier in armor: the belt of truth, the breastplate of doing right, the shoes of peace, the shield of faith, the helmet of salvation and the sword of God's word.
